summary: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of a previously announced exchange agreement with the trust of its CEO, William Alessi. Under the exchange, 3,870,000 shares of Series C Preferred Stock were exchanged for 109,588,265 shares of Class A common stock, increasing outstanding common shares to 164,884,640. The stated purpose is to regain compliance with Nasdaq's MVLS alternative listing standard (minimum $35 million market value) and reduce the stockholders' deficit. No price per share, premium, or outside advice is mentioned. This is a capital structure adjustment, not a special situation transaction.
